buildMode.header: The device half runs in Google Chrome's built-in model. The cloud half is connected: drafts and rewrites use gemini-3.5-flash-lite, and the second reader uses gemini-3.8-flash.

offlineDraft.deviceDraftText:
Case Note

Attendance was recorded for Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea during this visit.  She indicated a recurrence of mould in the back bedroom, with worsening conditions noted by the window.  Communication with the landlord has been unsuccessful, as two emails sent have not yet received a response.  She disclosed missing the deadline for a benefits form last week, and the correspondence pertaining to this is present. The date of birth provided was form 3/3/87. A plan was agreed to contact the landlord on Monday. She will submit the form by Friday, with assistance offered by a neighbour, Tomas Brandvold, who is also on the case’s list. The potential risk of rent arrears due to late form submission was identified.  A follow-up visit is scheduled for (place not put back).
